transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I've called us together for this emergency-readiness huddle to discuss stocking the rare emergency antidote at our satellite emergency department. As I understand it, we currently have no stock of this antidote on-site, and I'd like to hear from each of you before I make a final decision on whether and how to stock it. We do have a designated locked cabinet available in the medication room that could be used. I'd like to go around the table — could the clinical, pharmacy, and finance representatives each share your implementation requirements so I can make an informed decision?
